subject.title: refactor: separate external conversations from local sessions

question: Should OpenClaw commit to these three first-class conversation tools, Gateway RPCs, and durable per-agent delivery records as the permanent transport-generic API?
rationale: The linked issue remains explicitly marked for maintainer product review, and this branch creates model-facing, protocol, plugin-adjacent, and persisted-data contracts that cannot be safely treated as a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Keep the transport-generic design, resolve the merge conflicts, and require upgrade plus live Reef proof before landing.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Land only the generic core seam and Reef implementation while deferring the public tools or durable RPC contract until the API is smaller.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep using explicit message-tool channel targets until maintainers settle the long-term conversation identity and correlation model.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the transport-generic design, resolve the merge conflicts, and require upgrade plus live Reef proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked design, branch architecture, assignment, and successive implementation commits make steipete the clearest available owner for this product-contract decision.
